version: V3 single-issue RV32IM OoO, SRAM-tag four-way write-back cache and local resource control

critical_path.description: FIFO read/decode/dispatch to new fetch request credit/handshake

synthesis_rounds.change_and_limiting_path: Initial integrated CPU; shared dynamic register-bank and flush control fanout.
Final V2; critical Dcache refill tag metadata write control.
SRAM tags; registered BTB training; payload prewrite; remaining Dcache packed dirty/valid update fanout.
Four-way Dcache with per-row metadata and pipelined writeback; four-credit AXI writes; remove redundant older-store issue dependency. Remaining MDU payload request enable.
MDU IDLE payload prewrite removes request-valid gating. Remaining flush-dependent MDU availability in scheduler.
Raw resource availability independent of cancellation. Remaining branch comparison incorrectly participates in generic simple-operation class and EX hold enable.
Classify simple execution without branch-target fault cone; simplify I-response ready using reserved-slot invariant. Remaining FIFO head decode/rename admission to next I-request metadata.

small.coverage_note: Architectural commits always compared; only timing-dependent default-window OoO/speculation/prediction/pipeline coverage disabled for this small configuration.

writeback_faults.contract: Fault current triggering request; drain every B, preserve complete dirty line for retry, suppress killed Load errors, verify RAM before exit AW.

associativity_ablation.note: Same pre-final-timing RTL and capacity; only DCACHE_WAYS=2/4 differed. Final cycle-preserving timing edits retain four-way cycles.

performance_diagnostics.interpretation:
Summarize committed CPU_TRACE instruction timing without modifying the DUT.

Store COMMIT is the irrevocable D-cache request handshake, not ROB removal.
Consequently post-store commit gaps measure serialization, not exact B latency.
The subset whose successor was already COMPLETE is a conservative confirmed
serialization lower bound; other gap cycles may also include a slow successor.
Load lifetime and commit gaps overlap and must not be added as CPI components.

limitations: Single CPU LSU context; Loads cannot pass older Stores; no Store Buffer or forwarding.
Writeback faults belong to triggering request, not already-retired Store. Dirty line remains for retry.
All uncached/MMIO data accesses flush all dirty lines; exit drain cost included in cycles.
Cold full-system reset; no retained dirty data on reset, no self-modifying code/cache coherence.
Frequency is course ideal-clock/no-parasitics synthesis estimate; 2ns/500MHz timing target is not met.
IPC remains below course performance-tier minimum 0.6000.
